newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD 96/97 current profit seen falling 33 pct-paper.
newsitem.headline: KDD 96/97 current profit seen falling 33 pct-paper.

text.p: Parent current profit of Japanese international telecoms operator Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) in the year to March 31 is expected to fall 33 percent from the previous year to 21 billion yen, a Japanese business daily said at the weekend.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Saturday that the expected fall was larger than the fall forecast by the company itself.
The fall was due to a drop in revenues from the firm's telephone business partly due to a cut in its international telephone call charges last autumn, the paper said.
In November, KDD said it expected 1996/97 parent current profit of 24 billion yen, down 23.2 percent from the year before.
KDD was not immediately available for comment on the report.
